## Univariate Cox Model 

```{r}
vars <- c(
  "age", "sex", "trt",
  "ascites", "hepatomegaly", "spiders", "edema",
  "bili", "chol", "albumin", "copper",
  "alk_phos", "ast", "trig",
  "platelet", "protime", "stage"
)

uni_results <- lapply(vars, function(v) {

  formula <- as.formula(
    paste("Surv(futime, death) ~", v)
  )

  fit <- coxph(formula, data = pbc0)

  s <- summary(fit)

  data.frame(
    variable = v,
    HR = exp(coef(fit))[1],
    lower95 = exp(confint(fit))[1],
    upper95 = exp(confint(fit))[2],
    p_value = s$coefficients[,5]
  )

})

uni_results <- bind_rows(uni_results)

uni_results
```


```{r}
uni_results %>%
  arrange(p_value)
```


```{r}
pbc0 <- pbc0 %>%
  mutate(log_bili = log(bili))
```

## Multivariable Cox


```{r}
cox_full <- coxph(
  Surv(futime, death) ~ age + sex + trt +
  ascites + hepatomegaly + spiders + edema +
  log_bili + chol + albumin + copper + alk_phos +
  ast + trig + platelet + protime + stage,
  data = pbc0
)

summary(cox_full)
AIC(cox_full)
vif(cox_full)
```

```{r}
cox_model2 <- coxph(
  Surv(futime, death) ~ age + sex + edema + log_bili + albumin + protime + stage,
  data = pbc0
)

summary(cox_model2)
AIC(cox_model2)
vif(cox_model2)
```
```{r}
ph_test <- cox.zph(cox_model2)

ph_test
plot(ph_test)
```
Therefore, the extended Cox Proportional hazard model can be used and analyzed. 

```{r}
cox2_hr <- broom::tidy(cox_model2, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
  transmute(
    term_clean = term,
    HR = estimate,
    CI_lower = conf.low,
    CI_upper = conf.high,
    p_value = p.value,
    sig = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, "Significant", "Non-significant")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hr_direction = ifelse(HR < 1, "Protective (HR<1)", "Risk (HR>1)")
  )

cox2_hr$term_clean <- dplyr::recode(
  cox2_hr$term_clean,
  age = "Age",
  sexf = "Sex (female)",
  edema = "Edema",
  log_bili = "Log bilirubin",
  albumin = "Albumin",
  protime = "Prothrombin time",
  stage = "Stage"
)

cox2_hr$term_clean <- factor(
  cox2_hr$term_clean,
  levels = rev(cox2_hr$term_clean)
)

forest_cox2 <- ggplot(
  cox2_hr,
  aes(x = HR, y = term_clean, color = hr_direction, shape = sig)
) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = CI_lower, xmax = CI_upper),
    height = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8),
    labels = c("0.25", "0.5", "1", "2", "4", "8")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Protective (HR<1)" = "#2166ac",
      "Risk (HR>1)" = "#b2182b"
    ),
    name = "Effect Direction"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Non-significant" = 1
    ),
    name = "Significance"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hazard Ratios – Baseline Cox Model",
    subtitle = "Multivariable Cox model (95% CI)",
    x = "Hazard Ratio",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(forest_cox2)
```

## pbcseq (Time-varying model)

```{r}
pbcseq1 <- pbcseq %>%
  filter(!is.na(trt)) %>%
  transmute(
    id = id,
    day = day,
    futime = futime,
    status = status,

    death = as.integer(status == 2),
    transplant = as.integer(status == 1),

    trt = factor(trt),
    age = age,
    sex = factor(sex),

    ascites = ascites,
    hepatomegaly = hepato,
    spiders = spiders,
    edema = edema,

    bili = bili,
    chol = chol,
    albumin = albumin,
    alk_phos = alk.phos,
    ast = ast,
    platelet = platelet,
    protime = protime,
    stage = stage
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, day) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    tstart = day,
    tstop = lead(day),
    last_row = row_number() == n(),
    tstop = if_else(last_row, futime, tstop),
    event_death = as.integer(last_row & death == 1),
    event_transplant = as.integer(last_row & transplant == 1),
    log_bili = log(bili)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(tstart < tstop)
```


```{r}
# Sanity check 
pbcseq1 %>% 
  select(id, futime, status, day, tstart, tstop, event_death)
```

```{r}
cox_ext1 <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event_death) ~ age + sex + edema + log_bili + albumin + protime + stage + cluster(id),
  data = pbcseq1
)

summary(cox_ext1)
```

```{r}
# Sanity check

length(unique(pbc0$id))

length(unique(pbcseq1$id))

library(dplyr)

death_count_seq <- pbcseq1 %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(n_death = sum(event_death, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

table(death_count_seq$n_death)
death_count_seq %>% filter(n_death > 1)
```

```{r}
ids_pbc0 <- sort(unique(pbc0$id))

setdiff(ids_pbc0, ids_seq)

length(intersect(ids_pbc0, ids_seq))
length(ids_pbc0)
length(ids_seq)

# Sanity check 
death_pbc <- pbc %>%
  filter(status == 2) %>%
  pull(id)

death_pbcseq <- pbcseq1 %>%
  filter(death == 1) %>%
  pull(id) %>%

setdiff(death_pbcseq, death_pbc)
```

### Comparison forest plot 
```{r}
library(broom)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)

extract_ci <- function(fit, model_name) {
  broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    transmute(
      model = model_name,
      term = term,
      HR = estimate,
      lower = conf.low,
      upper = conf.high
    )
}

hr_long <- bind_rows(
  extract_ci(cox_model2, "Baseline Cox"),
  extract_ci(cox_ext1, "Extended Cox")
) %>%
  mutate(
    term = dplyr::recode(
      term,
      age = "Age",
      sexf = "Sex (female)",
      edema = "Edema",
      log_bili = "Log bilirubin",
      albumin = "Albumin",
      protime = "Prothrombin time",
      stage = "Stage"
    ),
    direction = ifelse(HR < 1, "Protective", "Risk")
  )

term_order <- hr_long %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  summarise(meanHR = mean(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(meanHR) %>%
  pull(term)

hr_long <- hr_long %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = term_order))

p_forest <- ggplot(
  hr_long,
  aes(
    x = HR,
    y = term,
    xmin = lower,
    xmax = upper,
    shape = model,
    color = direction
  )
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
  geom_pointrange(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    size = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Protective" = "#2166ac",
      "Risk" = "#b2182b"
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Baseline Cox" = 16,
      "Extended Cox" = 17
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of Hazard Ratios",
    subtitle = "Baseline Cox vs Time-Varying Cox Model",
    x = "Hazard Ratio",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Effect Direction",
    shape = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p_forest

ggsave(
  filename = "forest_compare.png",
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```


## Competing risk Model 

```{r}
pbc_fg <- pbc0 %>%
  mutate(
    fg_status = case_when(
      death == 1 ~ 2,
      transplant == 1 ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    id, futime, fg_status,
    age, sex, edema, log_bili, albumin, protime, stage
  ) %>%
  na.omit()
```

```{r}
X_fg <- model.matrix(
  ~ age + sex + edema + log_bili + albumin + protime + stage,
  data = pbc_fg
)[, -1]
```

```{r}
fg_death <- crr(
  ftime = pbc_fg$futime,
  fstatus = pbc_fg$fg_status,
  cov1 = X_fg,
  failcode = 2,
  cencode = 0
)

summary(fg_death)
```


```{r}
fg_coef <- fg_death$coef
fg_se <- sqrt(diag(fg_death$var))

fg_results <- data.frame(
  term = names(fg_coef),
  HR = exp(fg_coef),
  lower95 = exp(fg_coef - 1.96 * fg_se),
  upper95 = exp(fg_coef + 1.96 * fg_se),
  p_value = 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(fg_coef / fg_se)))
)

fg_results
```

```{r}
fg_results <- fg_results %>%
  mutate(
    sig = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Significant", "Non-significant"),
    direction = ifelse(HR < 1, "Protective (HR<1)", "Risk (HR>1)")
  )

fg_results$term <- dplyr::recode(
  fg_results$term,
  age = "Age",
  sexf = "Sex (female)",
  edema = "Edema",
  log_bili = "Log bilirubin",
  albumin = "Albumin",
  protime = "Prothrombin time",
  stage = "Stage"
)

fg_results$term <- factor(
  fg_results$term,
  levels = rev(fg_results$term)
)
```

```{r}
forest_fg <- ggplot(
  fg_results,
  aes(x = HR, y = term, color = direction, shape = sig)
) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower95, xmax = upper95),
    height = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8),
    labels = c("0.25", "0.5", "1", "2", "4", "8")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Protective (HR<1)" = "#2166ac",
      "Risk (HR>1)" = "#b2182b"
    ),
    name = "Effect Direction"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "Significant" = 16,
      "Non-significant" = 1
    ),
    name = "Significance"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hazard Ratios - Fine-Gray Model",
    subtitle = "Death as event of interest, transplant as competing event",
    x = "Subdistribution Hazard Ratio",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(forest_fg)
ggsave(
  filename = "forest_fg.png",
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```
